report.explanation: Gateway telemetry for the alert window is healthy: 0.12% error rate, p95 78ms, OK traces, 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. This contradicts the checkout error/latency alert and does not support any taxonomy cause. No downstream service telemetry is available, so no bounded candidate can be established; hand off for further evidence.
